BiblicalUsage: tsâʻar describes to be small, i.e. ignoble. It appears 3 times in Scripture, including Jeremiah 30:19 and Zechariah 13:7.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsâʻar belongs in His Word because the idea it carries belongs there.
